title: Elvis Starr's memoir tape about meeting Ransone in the White House

tellings.quote: '70s. Like there's a tape of him saying like I met Valerie Ransone in the White House.

plain: A man named Elvis Starr is said to have recorded a tape in the 1970s, dictating his memoir, in which he says he met a woman named Valerie Ransone in the White House. An unnamed researcher brings it up on the show without saying where the tape is, describing it as "a tape of him saying, like, I met Valerie Ransone in the White House." If the tape says that, it would put Ransone inside the White House in that decade, though the researcher's summary does not say why she was there or what came of the meeting.
